ends.start: W: at the pass mouth between Lighthouse Point and Deception Island, where the channel still has walls (~800 m). The seed used to run 500 m further west into Rosario Strait; out there the cross-section is open water whose area grows with whatever search window it is given (1670 m at half-width 900, 2270 m at 1500, 3270 m at 2500), so those sections measured the window, not the channel. Rosario Strait is the junction spec 2 says to stop at.
ends.end: E: past Yokeko Point (PUG1629), stopping at the Similk Bay / Swinomish Channel junction where the channel fans out

notes.flood_direction: Flood sets EAST through the pass. anchor.flood_deg 101.5 is PUG1701's floodDirection in Slackwater/Resources/currents.json; NOAA CO-OPS reports meanFloodDir 108 for bin 33 of the same station. Seed drawn W->E.
notes.spring_max_kn: max |Velocity_Major| = 8.73 kn at 2026-11-26 02:06Z, from CO-OPS currents_predictions interval=6 over the spring week 2026-11-23..2026-11-30 (full moon 2026-11-24). Also the 2026 annual maximum for the station.
notes.cd_to_mwl_m: MSL - MLLW at NOAA 9448614 BOWMAN BAY, FIDALGO ISLAND (1.2 km NW of the pass) = 8.73 - 4.10 ft = 4.63 ft = 1.411 m. The brief's suggested 9448558 is LA CONNER, Swinomish Slough (10.9 km away, 5.96 ft / 1.817 m) - Bowman Bay is nearer and on the anchor side. A pass whose whole point is a cross-pass head difference does not have one datum offset; the cd=0 sensitivity variant (spec 6b.2) is the axis that covers this.
notes.pass_island: East of the throat the seed used to run [-122.6425, 48.4065] -> [-122.6405, 48.4073], which crosses the east tip of Pass Island: at lon -122.6420 the main pass is at lat 48.4055-48.4065 and the deep lobe at 48.4075-48.4085 is a separate body until they merge near -122.6400. The seed now follows the main (south) channel. Before the refinement was slew-limited this was masked -- the unconstrained deepest-point jump landed in the north lobe, so the station sat on the island and its section measured the wrong water.
notes.west_end_trim: The first two seed points [-122.6640, 48.4098] and [-122.6605, 48.4090] were replaced by [-122.6592, 48.4086] for the reason in ends.start. Nothing east of the mouth changed and no check station is affected (PUG1629 is at the east end).
notes.bathymetry: NOAA Office of Coast Survey National Bathymetric Source. BlueTopo has NO Pacific Northwest coverage in the noaa-ocs-nationalbathymetry-pds bucket, so the 4 m NOAA Navigation Test-and-Evaluation BAG surfaces from the same bucket and programme are used. Same vertical datum (MLLW), same elevation-up sign convention. See data/tiles/deception-pass/MANIFEST.json.
